extraction: Compile unmodified AST nodes of original v1 loop from before=state1 through v1_rows.append, plus original mse function. Execute same compiled code object in all four calls. Never execute original main.
comparison_convention: Policy uses original strict > with no epsilon. Branch identity, actual carry, and tie score equality are exact execution checks. Independent Fraction-oracle value residuals use 1e-12 tolerance, not proof of bit equality to rational algebra.

fixtures.initial_theta: actual mutable state1 left by promote, never reset

costs: beta*(gain1-gain0) recorded from identical promote candidate calculation

oracle.number_system: Fractions from exact decimal strings, independent scalar normal equations and residual polynomial
oracle.carried_state: exact promoted Fraction candidate then one new n=9 decision
oracle.tie_price: (5/2)*gain1 in algebra; actual binary price is constructed from recorded same-policy gain for an exact binary score tie

limits: Four deterministic decision calls only. No v0 rerun, historical grid, policy rewrite, OR/quantum rerun, model-reader call, optimisation or original overwrite.
